title: Revision Request
description: Line-based requests named <complete-original-filename>.rr. Opening or changing status metadata never applies a source edit.

path.description: Forward-slash path relative to the VS Code workspace folder containing this .rr file. Must remain inside that folder. Use nonempty segments; . and .., Windows reserved device names, colons, backslashes, and trailing dots or spaces are rejected.

time.description: Creation time in ISO 8601 with timezone. Generators add it automatically. Missing time in hand-written requests is filled from file creation time when reviewed.

request.description: Each entry is one atomic review decision. Empty arrays have no pending requests.

line.description: 1-based line in the original request baseline. Insertions occur before this line; original line count + 1 appends. Line numbers do not shift when other entries are accepted.

before.description: Exact single-line fragment that occurs once in the indicated original line, or null to insert a complete new line. For deletion, provide the full original line content. No CR or LF.

after.description: Single-line replacement fragment, or null to delete the indicated original line. For insertion, provide the complete new line. Empty string is text/a blank line, not null. No CR or LF.

reason.description: Optional explanation for this entry; blank or absent disables Why. At most 50000 UTF-8 bytes.

status.description: New requests start pending. Accept/Ignore/Undo update this metadata; manually changing it never applies a source edit.

defaultSnippets.label: Revision Request
defaultSnippets.description: Create a pending line change; creation time is filled automatically when reviewed.
